title: BREAKING: Juan Frausto arrested on family-violence felony charge
excerpt: Juan Frausto was booked into the Webb County Jail on Oct. 24 on an alleged third-degree felony charge of assaulting a family or household member by impeding breath or circulation, plus a second-offense DWI count. Bond was not set.
content:
LAREDO — A 29-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail early Saturday morning on an alleged family-violence felony charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Juan Frausto was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 5:04 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department. The booking record lists assault of a family or household member by impeding breath or circulation — a third-degree felony — and driving while intoxicated, second offense, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was not set on either charge.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
